[ENGLISH VERSION - 42.06]

42.06 Articles of gut (other than silk-worm gut), of goldbeater's skin, of bladders or of tendons.

This heading includes :

(1) Catgut, manufactured by twisting strips of cleaned and dried gut, especially sheep’s gut. Catgut is used mainly in the manufacture of rackets, of fishing tackle and of machinery parts.

The heading excludes, however, sterile surgical catgut or similar sterile suture materials (heading 30.06) or gut put up or prepared as musical instrument strings (heading 92.09).
